summary: Unlock your potential in portfolio management with our expert training. Learn to prioritize and balance projects for maximum efficiency and success.
lede: Project portfolio management helps professionals overseeing multiple projects prioritize investments and balance work against organizational goals. Designed for portfolio, project, resource, and business decision-makers, this course addresses choosing feasible work amid competing priorities and capacity limits. Learners define evaluation criteria and use weighted scoring to rank projects, balance portfolio risk and resource capacity, and track benefits against strategic outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage multiple projects and must make strategic investment decisions. It targets those who need to prioritize work, balance resources, and ensure alignment with organizational goals. PMO Leaders:
audience: Define and enforce portfolio governance and prioritization
Project Managers: Align individual project execution
Senior Decision-Makers: Approve project investments based
Business Analysts: Evaluate project feasibility and benefits
Strategic Planners: Translate organizational goals into portfolio
IT Directors: Prioritize digital transformation projects
Finance Officers: Assess ROI and financial viability
Change Managers: Manage stakeholder resistance to project
Operations Managers: Balance operational projects with strategic
modules: Digital Tools and AI in Portfolio Management
Capstone: Portfolio Prioritization and Balancing Report
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites required, but a working knowledge of project management basics (e.g., understanding of ROI, risk, and resources) is recommended. Participants should bring a laptop with Excel or a spreadsheet tool installed to complete the hands-on exercises.
